name: Media Madness
source:
When Gameshow guy challenges News broadcaster to a battle of ratings in exchange for a months cable, News broadcaster couldn't say no. Who will win? Find out in this short visual novel!

[From [url=https://hypercandychan.itch.io/media-madness]itch.io[/url]]
